title: Cookie Notice
description: Which cookies and local storage SignalNest uses, and how to control them.
heading: Cookie Notice
body:
This notice explains the storage this website uses in your browser.

Strictly necessary

The site stores no login session and requires no cookie to display a page.

Preferences

signalnest-theme stores your light or dark theme choice in local storage. It contains a single word, is never sent to a server, and you can clear it at any time through your browser settings.

Analytics

If a Google Analytics 4 measurement ID is configured, Google Analytics sets cookies to distinguish sessions and measure page views. When the measurement ID is empty, no analytics script is loaded and no analytics cookies exist.

Advertising

If display advertising is enabled and approved, the advertising network may set cookies or read device identifiers to limit repetition and measure delivery. Advertising is enabled only through the site configuration, and the network's own notice applies in addition to this one.

Newsletter

The newsletter form posts an email address to the configured provider endpoint. The provider's own cookie and privacy terms apply.

Controlling storage

You can clear or block storage through your browser settings. Blocking the theme preference only means the site follows your system colour scheme instead.

Configuration required before launch

If analytics or advertising is enabled, name the providers, their cookie names and lifetimes here, and add a consent mechanism if the law in your jurisdiction requires one.
